literal: To those who do [things] after deliberating with chosen associates and planning [carefully], there is not even one difficult matter.
translation: For those who act after consulting with chosen associates and deliberating deeply, there is no task too difficult to achieve.
modern: ஆராய்ந்து தேர்ந்தெடுக்கப்பட்ட நண்பர்களுடன் ஆலோசித்து, செயலைப்பற்றி நன்கு சிந்தித்துச் செயல்படுபவர்களுக்கு, செய்வதற்கு அரிய செயல் என்று ஒன்றுமே இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the power of collective deliberation and thorough planning before undertaking any action. The phrase 'தெரிந்த இனத்தொடு' refers to wise, reliable associates who have been carefully chosen for their counsel. 'தேர்ந்து எண்ணி' highlights the process of analyzing and planning the course of action in consultation with them. For those who proceed with such meticulous preparation, the poet declares that there is no 'அரும்பொருள்' (difficult task or rare achievement) that remains impossible ('யாதொன்றும் இல்').
